citation.title: On FIRE mode in KSTAR
citation.authors: Na, Yong-Su; Park, S.J.; Han, H.; Lee, Janghyeok; Heo, C.; et al. (KSTAR Team)

topic: Overview of the KSTAR FIRE-mode scenario: ion ITB, possible I-mode edge, MHD, fast-ion dilution, TGLF predictive modelling
own_question: How is FIRE mode accessed, what characterizes its core, edge and MHD behaviour, and what explains its confinement enhancement?
actual_method_and_evidence: Review of experiments across campaigns using CES ion-temperature profiles (edge Ti pedestal), TS/TCI density, ECEI coherence, BES WCM spectra and Mirnov data. Offline TRIASSIC power balance, CGYRO/GKW gyrokinetics and TGLF predictive modelling. Figures were not visually checked.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In KSTAR FIRE-mode discharges, the CES-fitted edge ion-temperature profile showed a pedestal-like structure that was absent in the density profile. BES detected an edge weakly coherent mode in some shots.
claim_checks.qualification: Applies only to USN discharges with q95~4. The I-mode identification is the authors' interpretation, and the WCM is not seen in every shot. The measurements are offline profile fits. The paper does not distinguish impurity Ti from main-ion Ti.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. The paper contains no nowcasting, no CES report timing and no real-time inputs.
validation_if_relevant: None applicable. TGLF predictions are compared with a single shot only.
forbidden_inferences: Do not imply that this paper uses BES/ECEI to estimate CES temperature.
Do not imply that it addresses KSTAR 2022 data or our chord.
Do not attribute any mechanism to our estimators.
Do not treat CES Ti as independent truth.
Do not equate ECEI electron fluctuations with ion temperature.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: This is optional context showing that pedestal ion temperature from CES and BES edge fluctuations are physically studied in KSTAR. It is not a nowcasting precedent, and it adds little that bears on our framing.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
